strings.Рязанская земля; Ярославский, Кашинский,: The Ryazan land; Yaroslavl, Kashin, Uglich, Tver and Oryol uyezds; the Russian North and the Northern Dvina
strings.деревня Титовская, севернорусский актовы: the village of Titovskaya, northern Russian act collection of the Antoniev-Siysky Monastery
strings.послух земельной купчей: witness to a land deed of purchase
strings.В августе 1516 года назван послухом купч: In August 1516 he was named as a witness (poslukh) to Maksim Nesterov's deed of purchase for a quarter of the village of Titovskaya.
strings.Анфилоф — личное имя; Моисеев сын, в ста: Anfilof is a personal name; Moiseyev syn, in the old rendering also Moseyev syn, is a direct patronymic from Moisey.
strings.Послух был свидетелем, удостоверявшим зе: A poslukh was a witness who certified a land transaction. The source does not report his own holdings, social estate or kinship with the parties.
strings.Это другой человек, не Анфилофий Иванов: This is a different person, not Anfilofy Ivanov syn, who is mentioned as the former owner in the same deed: they have different fathers, different places in the formulary and different legal roles.
strings.Одновременное присутствие двух носителей: The simultaneous presence of two bearers of a close name in one act shows that the name was rare but not unique; the coincidence of a name does not by itself prove identity.
strings.Связь с тверским Онфилоговом, Никольским: A link with the Tver Onfilogovo, Nikolskoye Svechino and the Yurlovs has not been established.
strings.Анфилоф — личное имя; Мосеев сын — патро: Anfilof is a personal name; Moseyev syn is a patronymic from Mosey, modern form Moisey.
strings.Заключительная формула гласит: «А на то: The closing formula reads: «А на то послус Микифор Матфеев сын, да Анфилоф Мосеев сын» ["And the witnesses to this: Mikifor, son of Matfey, and Anfilof, son of Mosey"]. The name Anfilof is written directly and is not reconstructed from a place name or a later surname.
strings.Послух участвовал в юридическом удостове: A poslukh took part in the legal certification of a deed of purchase. The act does not disclose his social estate, holdings or kinship with the parties.
strings.Разные отчества и разные места в формуля: Different patronymics and different places in the formulary rule out confusion with Anfilofy Ivanov syn.
strings.Почему два тёзки важнее одного: Why two namesakes matter more than one
strings.Два независимых носителя в одном акте оп: Two independent bearers in one act refute the temptation to declare any Anfilof found to be unique and therefore "ours". After this find, geography and the chain of ownership matter more than the rarity of the name.
strings.Анфилоф был дееспособным участником земе: Anfilof was a legally capable participant in a land act in 1516. But the word «послух» ["witness"] denotes a procedural role, not a social estate: he cannot be called a peasant, landowner or relative of the seller without another document.
strings.Совпадают эпоха и именное гнездо; не сов: The period and the name group coincide; a proven territory does not. The deed contains no Tver uyezd, Nikolskoye Svechino, Yurlovs, Khorvachi or neighbouring villages of the complex in question.
strings.До 1600 года имя Анфилоф/Анфилог, близки: Before 1600 the name Anfilof/Anfilog, the close forms Anfil/Onfil and derived patronymics are documented in at least seven regional settings. The northern series now includes the Anfilovskaya village of 1573 and the sheepskin-maker Anfilofy Novik Ivanov syn of 1575; the Vladimir muster roll (desyatnya) of 1596 shows on the primary scan the exact formula «Анфилов сын Вакина» ["Anfilov son of Vakin"]. This makes the model of several independent family formations more probable than the search for one common incoming founder, but the towns of origin of the seven Oryol lines have not yet been established.
strings.ИМЕНА И МЕХАНИЗМ. Реестр показывает две:
NAMES AND MECHANISM. The register shows two different stages. In the first, Anfilof, Anfilog or the close documentary forms Anfil and Onfil are the personal name of a specific man: Anfilof Selivanov, Anfilofy Ivanovich, Anfilof Moiseyevich, Anfilog Ivanovich Konstantinov, Onfilof Nesterov, Onfil Ivanov, Anfil Vakin of Vladimir and Anpilog Ivanovich Onanyin. In the second, the name becomes a dependent naming of another person: Antipa Anfilogov syn, Peshok Anfilofov syn, Tonkoi Onfilogov and Antip Anfilov syn Vakina. Hence the -ov form existed as a patronymic or family naming long before it can confidently be regarded as a hereditary surname.

THE 16TH-CENTURY INTERVAL. The Kurostrov scrolls give a dense cross-section: in 1549 Onfilof Nesterov pays together with his nephew, in the 1550s he is probably repeated as «Анфилофей Несте…» ["Anfilofey Neste…"], and in 1592 Onfil Ivanov is recorded separately. In 1596 the Vladimir muster roll adds the formula «Антип Анфилов сын Вакина» ["Antip Anfilov son of Vakin"], which on the primary scan clearly separates the patronymic Anfilov and the third naming Vakin. Nearby occur Petrok Anfilov and a long line of Anfal / Anfalov. They are kept for comparison but not mixed into the main series: A. F. Bek's reference book lists Anfalov from Aifal/Anfal separately from Anfilov from Amfilokhy or Anfim.

GEOGRAPHY. The bearers do not form a single linear path. They appear simultaneously in the Ryazan land, Yaroslavl, Kashin, Vladimir, the Russian North, the Northern Dvina and Uglich. This distribution is too wide for the assumption of one common recent ancestor. Ryazan stands out for the repetition of the name in different generations and for its proximity to the documented resettlement of servicemen to the new southern towns; the Kashin–Uglich circle for its proximity to the Tver Onfilogovo; Vladimir for a formula contemporary with Oryol but independent. None of them has yet been connected to Oryol by a personal move.

MEANING FOR THE ORYOL CORE. In Oryol in 1594/95 there already existed at least seven fathers of surname bearers: Mikula, Vasily, Persha, Timofey, Nechay, Pakhom and Terenty. At the same time, in another Oryol nest, a pomeshchik with the personal name Anpilog Onanyin is known. The most economical new model is not to look for one ready-made family that suddenly arrived in Oryol, but to examine several families in which the name Anfilog could independently have turned into a patronymic and then into a stable family naming.
strings.Найти служебные продолжения рязанских но: Find service continuations of the Ryazan bearers of the name between the 1530s and the founding of Oryol.
strings.Вернуться к Лодыгиным только при появлен: Return to the Lodygins only if a patronymic, inherited land or a direct formula of transfer between the Kashin circle and southern service appears.
strings.Искать семерых орловских отцов по полным: Search for the seven Oryol fathers by full formulas and former pomestyes, without assuming a common surname in advance.
strings.Заказать однолистные акты Архива СПбИИ Р: Order the single-sheet acts of the Archive of the St Petersburg Institute of History of the Russian Academy of Sciences (SPbII RAN), f. 5, op. 1, d. 554 and 567: check the boundaries of the Anfilovskaya village and the full formulary of Anfilofy Novik's deed of purchase.
strings.Не объединять региональные случаи без пр: Do not merge regional cases without a direct kinship or migration formula.
strings.В августе 1516 года одна земельная купча: In August 1516 a single land deed of purchase independently named the former owner Anfilofy Ivanov syn and the witness Anfilof Moiseyev syn.
strings.КТО НАЗВАН. Одна купчая августа 1516 год:
WHO IS NAMED. One deed of purchase of August 1516 preserves two different bearers of the rare name at once: Anfilofy Ivanov syn and Anfilof Moseyev syn. These are not two readings of one line: they stand in different parts of the formulary, have different fathers and perform different legal roles.

THE FIRST PERSON. Anfilofy Ivanov syn was the former holder of a quarter of the village of Titovskaya. Maksim Nesterov directly derived his right from an earlier purchase from him. Consequently, a name close to Onfilog was borne by a man who disposed of a share of a settlement and could alienate land.

THE SECOND PERSON. Anfilof Moiseyev syn is named as a witness (poslukh) to the new deed of purchase. He helped to certify the transaction legally, but the document does not report his social estate, holdings or kinship with the parties.

MEANING FOR THE SEARCH. The simultaneous appearance of two namesakes shows that the name was rare but not unique. Therefore a single coincidence of name is not enough: the decisive factor must be a documentary bridge to Nikolskoye Svechino, the Yurlovs or Tver uyezd. The northern Titovskaya does not yet provide such a bridge.
strings.Не установлены точная современная локали: The exact modern location of the village of Titovskaya and the further biographies of both Anfilofs have not been established.
